scope: Checksum-reviewed IHP ntap1/ptap1 schematic bindings, computed resistance and selected local electrical/editor acceptance. No complete device-family or physical qualification.

windows_backend.scope: Windows staging, actual source backend on local Linux ngspice 42, and hash-verified artifact receipt. Not installed acceptance.

Windows.scope: Current-source offscreen desktop; placement, parameter editing, computed resistance, save/reopen/netlist. Not installed acceptance.

Linux.scope: Current-source offscreen desktop; placement, parameter editing, computed resistance, save/reopen/netlist. Not installed acceptance.

layout_probe.error: Netgen did not establish a unique match with equivalent connected pins and no property errors. See lvs/lvs.log.
layout_probe.scope: Exploratory one-rectangle ntap layout; failed LVS is not qualification.

retained_failures: Editor probes exposed harness assumptions about registry JSON formatting, deferred widgets and numeric SPICE export; corrected before accepted runs.
Initial broad regression rejected the new default in the old NPN recipe. Historical-input reconstruction correction passes five focused tests per host.
The exploratory ntap layout passes DRC but fails strict LVS. Physical integration remains open.
limitations: Sampled geometry, biases, frequencies and temperatures only; no continuous operating/reliability envelope.
Identical public electrical tap models require a separate emitted-identity check; numerical results cannot detect swapping their names.
No tap physical-extraction, latchup/ESD, measured calibration, statistical or installed-release acceptance.
Other required devices, complete upstream coverage and final installed acceptance keep chunk 7 incomplete.

restore_check.scope: Restored byte-exact model package, implementation and one complete electrical case; checker regression executed from restored sources. No new full electrical run claimed.
